title: Fogmog
move_pattern: Starts with Illusory Spores. Then cycles through Thwack. After each Thwack, randomly uses either another Thwack followed by Headbutt (40%) or just Headbutt (60%), then returns to Thwack.
notes: Fogmog summons an EyeWithTeeth companion on its opening move. The monster gains 1 Strength each time it uses Thwack, making it progressively more dangerous as the fight continues.
